summary: Flathead NF cabin in Lake County, MT; one listing dates it to 1926 and says it was destroyed in 1972; not on the manning schedule in summer 1955 and no longer maintained by 1957; listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Destroyed 1972 per firelookout.com; Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as gone

staffing.status: not on manning schedule in summer 1955

Plum Creek Logging Co. of Columbia Falls began building the road to the lookout
Daily Inter Lake: many sightseers reached the mountain that summer; only a short hike from the trail was needed to reach the lookout

notes_for_editor: The 1926 build date and 1972 destruction rest on firelookout.com; the Weebly page corroborates the 1972 vandalism and planned burning but does not name the building, and calls it an outlook. The 1956 Coast and Geodetic Survey text describes a small white house at the survey mark, which suggests a building was still there in 1956. Brief's status 'gone' and county match both lists. No corrections proposed. Nothing found on what remains at the site or on public access; the access field is left out.
